subject: SCCs certification clauses & subprocessor ops playbook
messages:
From: Claire Hammond <claire.hammond@sagewell.health>
To: jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@legalshore.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask — SCCs/UK IDTA coverage for EU patient data

Hi Jordan / Kimberly —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we scope procurement with legal, we need clarity on a few things to satisfy our privacy team before signing the DPA: 

- Can you confirm which standard SCCs you rely on for EU→US transfers and whether Redwood can provide a signed copy?
- For UK data subjects, does Redwood sign the UK IDTA addendum or do you offer the standalone UK addendum?
- We operate with a handful of sub-processors that will be co-located with our workloads; SageWell needs proof of subprocessor certification for security controls (ISO/AICPA evidence) rather than just a list. Is there a way to provide attestation or a letter?

If you can share a checklist of deliverables and an estimated timeline to get evidence into our portal (drive link below), that would be great.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSageWellEvidence

Best,
Claire Hammond
Director of Privacy, SageWell Health

From: jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
To: Claire Hammond <claire.hammond@sagewell.health>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — SCCs/UK IDTA coverage for EU patient data

Hi Claire —

Thanks — great questions. Short answers up front: 

1) SCCs: Redwood uses the European Commission Standard Contractual Clauses (2010/87/EU style equivalent) and we provide an executed SCC annex for customers on request. We have a standard amendment flow when customers need signed copies.

2) UK: We support both the UK IDTA pattern and a UK-specific addendum. For SageWell's case (regulated health data), I recommend the signed UK Addendum (we can attach it to the DPA).

3) Subprocessor certification: We maintain a subprocessor matrix and can provide redacted SOC2 summary pages and ISO attestations for the datacenter and managed services processors. For suppliers where we are a reseller or reseller-managed, we can provide a formal attestation letter. If SageWell needs per-subprocessor paperwork uploaded to your portal, we'll need a scoped list and a PO or procurement intake so we can prioritize.

I'll loop in Marissa (legal) and Kim (security) to propose the checklist and timing. Expect a detailed email tomorrow with attachments.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: Claire Hammond <claire.hammond@sagewell.health>, jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — SCCs/UK IDTA coverage for EU patient data

Claire / team —

Appreciate the list, Claire. Attached is a short checklist (SageWell_SCCs-checklist.xlsx) that maps the typical deliverables we provide during DPA onboarding for regulated customers. Key notes: 

- We can execute the SCC annex and the UK Addendum (Signed-UK-IDTA-addendum.pdf) as part of the DPA signature packet.
- For subprocessor evidence: we can provide (a) subprocessor matrix with roles and regions, (b) SOC2 summary pages for infra providers, and (c) a redacted penetration test summary for our managed runtime. We do not publish vendor full reports without an NDA and specific attestation request.
- Turnaround: if SageWell provides a prioritized list of required subprocessor documents (e.g., full SOC2 for infra vs. attestation letter for CDN), we can commit to a 10 business day delivery for priority items once the procurement PO or intake is in place.

Kim, can you confirm whether the security team is comfortable with the proposed attestation letter template (I included a draft paragraph in the attached matrix)?

Tom (cc) — if Legal has specific redline requests to the SCCs or the UK Addendum, please advise and we’ll route to executive approvals.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Privacy & Contracts | Redwood Inference
Attachments: SageWell_SCCs-checklist.xlsx

From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, Claire Hammond <claire.hammond@sagewell.health>, jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — SCCs/UK IDTA coverage for EU patient data

Marissa / Claire —

I reviewed the draft attestation language and the checklist. A couple of operational clarifications: 

- For subprocessor certification: we can provide an attestation letter that confirms the subprocessor maintains SOC2 Type II or ISO27001, but we will not share raw SOC2 reports without a mutual NDA. The attestation will include the subprocessor name, control scope, and last audit date.
- For on-prem/reseller scenarios: where SageWell requires on-site evidence from a subprocessor, that will typically require an addendum to the SOW and a cost pass-through. 
- Logging and retention: our default logs retention is 90 days for token-level traces; we can provide longer retention under contract and list those requirements in the TIA/DTIA appendix.

I attached the current subprocessor matrix (RI_subprocessor_matrix_v2.pdf) — note the entry for our storage partner in eu-west-1 (they maintain ISO27001 + SOC2).

If SageWell needs us to sign a bespoke certification for each listed processor, we recommend an NDA first, then a prioritized list (top 3) and we'll start evidence collection.

Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Privacy Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: RI_subprocessor_matrix_v2.pdf

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@legalshore.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Claire Hammond <claire.hammond@sagewell.health>, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 1 Aug 2028 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — SCCs/UK IDTA coverage for EU patient data

Marissa / Jordan —

We reviewed the proposed DPA attachments. A few legal touchpoints: 

- SageWell requests a signed UK IDTA addendum and the SCC annex to be attached to the DPA. Please confirm whether Redwood will accept a single-execution model (Redwood signs once, counterparty signs once) or if Redwood requires a two-party signature workflow.
- Regarding subprocessor attestations: we appreciate the attestation approach; however, our compliance team requires a signed letter from Redwood that lists each subprocessor and confirms the stated certifications. The letter needs to be on Redwood letterhead and signed by a senior security officer.
- For TIAs: we need an explicit clause describing where (region) logs will physically be stored and an option to retain key logs for up to 2 years for auditability. Please propose language in the TIA appendix.

We can turn around a redline to the DPA once we get the SCC and UK addendum attachments. Can you provide the signed addendum by COB next Tuesday?

—Tom
Tom Reynolds
Senior Counsel, Legalshore (external counsel for SageWell)
From: jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
To: Claire Hammond <claire.hammond@sagewell.health>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@legalshore.com>, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 1 Aug 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — SCCs/UK IDTA coverage for EU patient data

Claire / Tom —

Thanks — quick status update and commitments: 

1) Signatures: Redwood is fine with a single-execution model for the SCC annex + UK Addendum (we will countersign). Marissa will attach the signed PDFs to the DPA packet.

2) Subprocessor letter: Kim has agreed to produce the signed attestation on Redwood letterhead listing the processors and their certifications. We will include the attestation as a PDF (Signed-UK-IDTA-addendum.pdf included in packet). We note Redwood will request an NDA before sharing full SOC2 reports.

3) TIA language: Laura will draft a short TIA appendix for logs retention and physical regions; proposed language will include option for 2-year retention as a commercial add-on (billing TBD).

Next steps: 
- Marissa will circulate the DPA + attachments for signature today (DocuSign link to follow).
- Claire / SageWell: confirm top-3 subprocessor documents you need if you want fast-tracked evidence collection.

Appreciate the cadence — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments (to be added in DocuSign): Signed-UK-IDTA-addendum.pdf
